report:
Vulva, labium majus and clitoris (midline), radical vulvectomy

Received in formalin is a radical vulvectomy specimen measuring 110 x 80 x 30 mm. The specimen is orientated: suture at 12 o'clock. There is an ulcerated tumour on the labium majus and clitoris (midline) measuring 45 x 30 mm, 8 mm from the closest (posterior) margin. The margins are inked. Representative sections are taken in 10 blocks.

(1-4) Tumour with deep margin.
(5-8) Peripheral margins, 12 to 9 o'clock.
(9-10) Adjacent skin.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Radical vulvectomy
- Tumour site: Labium majus and clitoris (midline)
- Tumour size: 45 mm (greatest dimension)
- Tumour focality: Unifocal

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Squamous cell carcinoma, HPV-independent
- Tumour histology:
  The tumour is an HPV-independent squamous cell carcinoma with a keratinising pattern, invading to a depth of 7 mm. Infiltrating nests and cords of atypical squamous cells show abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, intercellular bridges and keratin pearls. On immunohistochemistry, p16 is negative and p53 shows an abnormal null pattern.
- Depth of invasion: 7 mm (conventional method: 8 mm)
- Tumour border: Infiltrating
- Other tissue / organ involvement: Lower one-third of the vagina
- Lymphovascular invasion: Present
- Perineural invasion: Not identified

Margins
- Invasive carcinoma, peripheral margin: Uninvolved (closest 7 mm, posterior)
- Invasive carcinoma, deep margin: Uninvolved (closest 2 mm)
- Squamous precursor lesion (dVIN): Uninvolved (closest 6 mm, posterior)

Lymph nodes
- Regional lymph nodes: 14 examined (lymphadenectomy); 2 involved
  - Metastasis more than 5 mm: 1 node
  - Metastasis more than 2 mm to 5 mm: 1 node
  - Size of largest metastatic deposit: 9 mm
  - Nodal sites with tumour: Right inguinal and right femoral
  - Extranodal extension: Present

Pathological stage (AJCC 9th edition)
- pTNM: pT2 pN1c

Additional findings
- Adjacent epithelium: Differentiated VIN (dVIN); lichen sclerosus

VULVA, labium majus and clitoris (midline), radical vulvectomy
- SQUAMOUS CELL CARCINOMA, HPV-INDEPENDENT, 45 mm, invading to a depth of 7 mm,
  involving the lower one-third of the vagina; completely excised (closest
  margin 2 mm, deep); see synoptic report
- 2 of 14 regional lymph nodes involved; extranodal extension present
- pT2 pN1c (AJCC 9th edition)
- Background differentiated VIN (dVIN) and lichen sclerosus

Depth of invasion is measured by the FIGO 2021 method.
